english: Krupaye krupaye krupaye yessaya antha nee krupaye
Na jeevitham saguthunnadhi na balamutho kadhu

Krupaye krupaye krupaye yessaya antha nee krupaye
intro: Antha Nee Krupa is the latest Telugu Christian worship song, translated and sung by Sudheer Daniel. The original Kannada lyrics and composition were created by Prakash Halmidi, with music arranged by Haxley Jon. The official music video premiered on August 15, 2025, on Sudheer Daniel official YouTube channel, drawing listeners into a deeper worship experience.
